title: init: one command from a project to a wired AI client
summary: Registers a project in the manifest, indexes it, finds its index and wires Claude Code, VS Code and Cursor to serve it, in one command
intro: Run drag-lint init --project plus your project file once per project (try --dry-run first) and an AI client can query that project's index: it registers the project, builds the index, then points Claude Code, VS Code and Cursor at it. It only runs existing verbs, so each step can also be run by hand.

help: runs register-project --apply, index --project, resolve-dbs --project, then mcp-config --all --db <that index>
(Claude Code, VS Code and Cursor; an uninstalled client is skipped); --dry-run prints those four commands and runs NOTHING;
--home-dir / --appdata-dir move where the client files are looked for (tests); a failing step stops the run with its exit code

questions.ask: What would init do for my project? (writes nothing)
Set up drag-lint for my project and my AI client in one go
